§3§lOptional. Two of them, both raised by the same projection.§r
A 17x17x20 hyperboloid shell on the platform strip to your §bLEFT§r as you stand at the front and look at the silo face - where step 3's plan view draws them. They are §bpieces of the main controller§r, not modules: no tower controller, no dock marker, and no maintenance hatch of their own.

§ePER TOWER§r
  §b736x§r Light Concrete §8(the flare)§r
  §b52x§r Solid Steel Machine Casing §8(the base ring, now a CLOSED ring)§r

§ePER STANDING TOWER§r (maximum two)
  feedwater draw §2x0.5§r
  passive heat decay §2x2§r
  decay-heat demand §2x0.5§r

[note]If you still own a "Plant Module - Cooling Tower" controller from an older version, it is a museum piece: it loads, it has no recipe, and it does nothing.[/note]

[warn]MIGRATION: a tower raised by that old controller has a GAP in its base ring where the controller stood. Break the retired controller and place §b2x Solid Steel Machine Casing§r per tower - the cell it stood in, and the cell directly outward of it toward the platform edge - or the tower will never be detected.[/warn]

[note]The 0.19.0 MAINTENANCE HATCH in that base ring can STAY - the ring cell TOLERATES one, so it is not a reason to take the tower apart. It is §bnot adopted§r: a tower hatch is never counted toward the plant's maintenance, which is the silo face, the Spiral floor and the manifold and nothing else. Replacing it with a Solid Steel casing is equally fine.[/note]

[note]§6A tower that has blocks standing and still refuses to form says WHY, on every panel.§r The REACTOR group's tier line ends with the tower inventory - §2Cooling Tower x1§r, or §8no cooling towers§r when there are none - and a failing one appends §cNW tower NOT FORMED:§r or §cSW tower NOT FORMED:§r with the reason. §8Before a silo is built there is no tier line yet, so that same inventory gets a line of its own opening §bCooling towers:§r.§r[/note]
